Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE native1254x1254 true-transparent RGBA sprite. Image1 is exact Moon Shadow Girl RUN NORTHEAST frame14. Image2 is her following NE16 and supplies only the narrower, more lengthwise visible sole during heel raise. Image3 supplies approved project painted rendering style.

Its toe currently swings abruptly toward screen-right in a strong sideways J shape compared with its calf/heel direction, making the ankle appear laterally twisted. Redraw that boot and tiny ankle junction with a narrower, straighter heel-to-toe longitudinal silhouette. Show a little more coherent rear sole and less broad side-facing forefoot. The sole recedes along the support calf's NE movement plane, rather than curling sideways across it. Keep a natural soft ankle bend and forefoot push, not a rigid stick. Use image2 only as continuity reference: this target remains its own frame, with its own knee bend and heel pitch. Do not copy image2 pose.
Preserve same anatomical support leg and the raised other foot. Keep the support boot ankle location, calf and knee, existing forefoot contact height/perspective, hips and fullcanvas composition. This is late rear propulsion/forefoot support, not flat landing; do not lift the contact or reposition the body. Keep all above-ankle anatomy, head/hair, NE view, identity, gold/navy costume, scarf and tails, both arms, two hands and exactly two crescent daggers unchanged. No whole-body scale, rotation, translation, mirroring, recentering or new pose. Keep warm gold boot details/navy leather/brown sole and clean high-finish handpainting. No floor, line, shadow, effects, text, grid or backdrop. Actual transparent alpha and complete character inside safe canvas edges.
